annotation_review.method: Second author pass over all 200 serialized open-only queries and target IDs against the complete frozen catalog, followed by review of corrected rows. Keyboard-layout transformations checked. No evaluated-model predictions used.

split_method: Preassigned object families; paired scenario families have the same split in both catalogs.

protocol.task: forced top-1 selection of one uniquely specified catalog object
protocol.metric_definition: Exactly matching object IDs / all split rows; no exclusion of abstentions, invalid IDs or failed predictions.
protocol.test_usage: Held-out confirmation after validation settings are frozen.
